capabilities.description: Answers queries against synthetic project workflows, epics, stories, and statuses.
capabilities.inputSemantics: JSON object {"query": string}. query supports 'get_story:<id>', 'get_workflow:<id>', 'list_active', 'list_blocked', 'search_stories:<term>' or 'search:<term>', and 'overview'.
capabilities.resultSemantics: JSON object {"summary": string, "facts": [{"name": string, "value": string}]}. Bounded: summary of matching entities and key facts.

fields.label: Advance Simulation on Fetch
fields.description: Advance simulation state on each fetch tick to simulate evolving work items
